title: Retire unused competitor-cost pricing comparison chain while retaining catalog pricing

source.ref: Exact f787 runtime/source-reader inventory plus current Frequency pricing route and rendered catalog tests

detail: The old PricingComparison -> ComparisonTable/lib/pricing/comparison chain has no active route, registered CLI/workflow, type API or registry consumer. Remove those three internal modules and their catalog-only legacy tests. Active FrequencyPricing remains fed by actual operator catalog, gates, offerings, annual amounts, extras and calculator. Existing real Frequency pricing/gate tests remain, and a new rendered override control proves an unusual actual catalog amount reaches the active page and its Business door. The historical Value Ladder pointer is clarified; semantic contrast enforcement remains. No billing policy, competitor price assertion, published page override or whole-app acceptance claim changed.

verify.note: Retired module absence plus actual FrequencyPricing route import/render. All-tree AST no-dangling-import checks, actual-route mutation controls and rendered operator-catalog override test supplement existing Frequency pricing tests.
